answer: Each agent may join only after locking a nontransferable stake that is slashed if its identity is caught double-signing the same task or colluding across mirrored accounts. A terrace of independent reviewers checks sampled work and publishes signed evidence, so one operator cannot cheaply multiply votes by minting names. The mirror records link repeated behavior, while ferrous escrow keeps the bond unavailable for trade. A sybil attacker must therefore tie up real capital in every identity and risks losing it.
